query: SELECT cm.title as module_title, COUNT(cl.id) as lesson_count, ROUND(AVG(LENGTH(cl.content))) as avg_content_length, MIN(LENGTH(cl.content)) as min_content_length FROM course_modules cm JOIN course_lessons cl ON cl.moduleId = cm.id GROUP BY cm.id, cm.title ORDER BY avg_content_length ASC LIMIT 10;
